summary: Hunter suffered a serious injury when a tree fell on them while sleeping in a tent in the Bears Ears area north of Hayden, early morning hours; Moffat County emergency services reached the subject and transported them to safety as RCSAR prepared to dispatch.
location: Bears Ears area north of Hayden
responding_agency: Moffat County emergency services; Routt County Search and Rescue (paged — Moffat EMS reached the subject first)
notes: Freshness sweep run 33: Steamboat Pilot via operanewsapp mirror (published 2026-10-20) + KZYR Zephyr Press Oct-16 newscast; third of three RCSAR pages within 14 hours during first rifle season.
